stage: Frozen generic decision program held-out choice evaluation
computation: Unchanged contract compiler, original provided answer options resolved through model-selected input_path, unchanged finite execution and collect reducer.
required_evidence: Generated candidate binding preserves all original option IDs and descriptions.
All assigned roots remain in quality denominators, with compilation failures recorded.
Warmup and measured programs and discrete outputs are compared.
Compiler-inclusive cost and actual physical batch sizes are recorded.
boundary: No new semantic program prompt or algorithm is selected from these outputs.
scope: Independent question quality and execution controls. This is not the single-query large-spawn scaling experiment.
timing_scope: Sum of compiler/model/reducer timings; model startup and CPU task preparation are excluded. No full end-to-end speed claim uses this timing.
